last_episode_to_air.name: Future - I've Always Wanted to Be a Family
last_episode_to_air.overview: Shintaro, mentally and physically exhausted from the battlefield, meets Asako in a fateful encounter that changes everything. Even before she offered herself as a substitute bride, Asako discovers that Shintaro had taken notice of her... When all of their secrets and feelings come to light, the couple brought together by a false union forms a genuine bond and passionately comes together!

name: Taisho Era Contract Marriage ~ The Substitute Bride and a Soldier's Fierce Love
original_name: 大正偽りブラヰダル～身代わり花嫁と軍服の猛愛
overview: I used to think there was no love in marriage... Until I met a fierce and passionate soldier! Despite being the daughter of a viscount, Asako is rejected by high society and treated as a nuisance by her parents. When a marriage proposal arrives suddenly for Asako's younger sister from none other than Captain Kido, a soldier known for his coldness, she doesn't hesitate for a moment. To protect her precious younger sister, Asako volunteers as... a substitute bride!
tagline: Bear my child instead of your sister...
